body.text: Open Guard Takedown and Escape Game

items: The bottom player wins by putting the top player down and standing up, or by rising up to a connection another way.
The top player wins with shin contact.

body.text: Figure Four to Precursor Positions Game

items: The top player wins by putting the bottom player's hand on the mat, behind his back, or locked on his arm.
The bottom player wins by freeing both of his own elbows.
